newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-POPESCU SCORES FOUR IN ROMANIA BIGGEST WIN FOR 24 YEARS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POPESCU SCORES FOUR IN ROMANIA BIGGEST WIN FOR 24 YEARS.

text.p: Romania crushed the part-timers of Liechtenstein 8-0 in a World Cup group eight qualifier on Saturday with Barcelona midfielder Gheorghe Popescu leading the rout with four goals.

Gheorghe Hagi, Viorel Moldovan, Dan Petrescu and Gheorghe Craioveanu completed the scoring which maintained Romania's 100 per cent record in the group with four wins out of four matches played and a goal difference of 18-0.

Romania could easily have had more goals, going close on at least another eight occasions against their totally outclassed opponents who have now lost all five of their qualifiers with a goal tally of 2-29. At least this score was something of an improvement on their last outing which ended in an 11-1 loss to Macedonia.
In the end they failed to hit double figures but still chalked up their biggest win since beating Finland 9-0 in a World Cup qualifier in Bucharest almost 24 years ago.

Leichtenstein's cause was not helped by heavy rain and a muddy field. But Romania's team, comprising 11 overseas-based players, totally domintated proceedings to stay on course for a place in the finals in France next year.

Romania are unlikely to have things quite as much their own way on Wednesday when they face Lithuania but whatever happens then, the Romanians will stay top of the group as they go into that game five points clear of second-placed Ireland.
